remarks: Discover Winnipauk Village in Norwalk - A Hidden Gem. Experience the charm of Winnipauk Village with this well-appointed corner unit condominium, offering a perfect blend of privacy and convenience. Nestled away yet close to shopping, dining, and easily accessible via I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, this location is ideal for commuters. Step inside to find hardwood floors throughout and an open-concept main level that seamlessly connects the dining and living areas. Enjoy cozy evenings by the fireplace as the seasons change. The first floor also includes a convenient half bath for guests. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms, each with ample closet space and abundant natural light. Both bedrooms feature their own full bathrooms, and laundry facilities are conveniently located in the hallway between them. Step out through sliding doors to your private patio, perfect for year-round relaxation. The community has additional amenities including two pools, tennis/pickle ball courts and a clubhouse, ideal for enjoying warmer months. Your unit includes one assigned parking space, with plenty of guest parking available right in front. Don't miss the opportunity to make this beautiful condo your home. Book your appointment today!
